toolbooks.description: ToolBooks is a US bookkeeping and payroll SaaS. The platform unifies accounting, bank reconciliation, invoicing and vendor payments into a single product for small businesses.
highlights: Lead the platform frontend: defined a Domain-Driven Feature architecture that scales to 23 product modules with no coupling between features.
Integrated real financial flows: bank linking with Plaid, payments with Stripe, and enterprise auth with AWS Cognito + NextAuth.
Built the bank statement import wizard end-to-end: bulk upload, client-side PDF preview and atomic transaction confirmation.
Hardened HTTP security (HSTS, X-Frame-Options, full header stack) and migrated critical widgets to real server state with TanStack Query.

precision-logistica.description: Precisión Logística is a Colombian freight transport and logistics company that integrates transport, logistics talent and technology to guarantee operational continuity for cargo-generating companies.
highlights: Designed and built the entire frontend from scratch for a transport-company SaaS on a Feature-Sliced Design architecture; delivered in four months.
Integrated RNDC, Colombia's government freight dispatch system, with a bulk importer (upload → preview → commit) and automatic classification.
Implemented role-based access control (13 roles, 6 portals) and moved the refresh token to an httpOnly cookie with Edge middleware route protection.
Set up the testing strategy with Vitest and Playwright: 219 tests, 80% coverage on critical areas, documented as ADRs.

geeks5g.description: Geeks5G is an Austin (USA) agency offering digital marketing, web design and custom software development for small and medium businesses.
highlights: Built the full frontend of Emergency Service (getservice.ai), a real-time dispatch platform for locksmiths now in production.
Implemented live SMS-confirmation state with seamless re-escalation, Google Maps geocoding and routes, and Twilio/Payarc status webhooks.
Defined the architecture: TanStack Query for server state, Redux for UI state, and a component system on shadcn/ui + Tailwind.

bancolombia.description: Bancolombia is one of Colombia's largest banks and a financial group present across several Latin American countries. It offers personal, business and investment banking services.
highlights: Built an internal monitoring interface that helped the team identify and resolve technical incidents faster in a high-criticality banking environment.
Contributed to multi-repo migrations and improved deployment reliability through Jest unit testing and rigorous code reviews.

dicosoft.description: DicoSoft Digital is a digital marketing agency specialized in medical clinics and practices, with complementary web development services. Its clients are mainly in healthcare (dentistry, dermatology, aesthetics).
highlights: Built responsive e-commerce platforms with React and SASS, integrating the MercadoPago gateway and optimizing the checkout experience.
Handled end-to-end deployments with Docker and Plesk for stable, high-availability client environments.

radkiddo.description: Rad Kiddo is a US-based kids' streetwear brand. It sells tees, hoodies, pants and shorts through a Shopify online store, shipping across the USA.
highlights: Built a hybrid e-commerce combining React for high-interactivity components with WordPress/WooCommerce for the catalog.
Integrated Cloudinary for media management and dynamic geolocation in the storefront.

About.label: About
About.title: Beyond the Code
About.quote: I see the frontend as part of a larger system.
bio: I trained as a mechatronics engineer with a postgraduate diploma in IoT before moving into the web. That background taught me to think through systems end-to-end before writing the first line of code.

For 3+ years I've built production SaaS with React, Next.js and strict TypeScript — recently leading the frontend of fintech and logistics platforms, integrating mission-critical services like Plaid, Stripe and AWS Cognito.
I care about architecture that scales, code quality that holds as the product grows, and the small details that make an interface feel alive.
